title: On ‘60 Minutes,’ Trump Says Immigration Crackdown May Have ‘Hurt’ Republicans in Elections
summary: The president was asked in a “60 Minutes” interview that aired on Sunday whether his deportation policies went too far. “I think it might be too tough,” he said.
